name: LLM forecasting agents (direct retrieval-and-reason forecasters trading the gap)
one_line: Retrieve, reason, calibrate, anchor to the price and trade the residual with a proper-scoring sizing rule; the baseline files 50-78 must beat, and on liquid markets the price still wins.
maturity: Emerging; benchmark parity with superforecasters but the market price still wins head to head; controlled real-money runs mostly negative, one small positive Kalshi pilot with proper betting; no attributable Polymarket PnL
requires_ai: yes; LLM retrieves, reads rules, outputs probability; sizing and risk deterministic
edge: Cheap breadth on unpriced new listings and thin long-tail toss-ups; bias fading
capital: $1k-$10k; capacity-bound (~$500 per market), API costs fixed
build_time: 3-5 weeks solo on an existing execution stack
opportunity_size: 877 long-tail toss-ups hold $1.05M; tail pool low tens of $k/month for all; shrinking
expected_results: Prediction Arena Polymarket -1.1% mean; Kalshi pilot +80% on $200 (trimmed +24%); guess -5% to +5%/month
competition: 191 GitHub repos, prop-firm agents, Mantic/FutureSearch; no audited results
flag: none for own trading; grey selling signals / auto-executing (CTA, Letter 26-25)
validate: Cutoff-staggered replay then 350+ pre-registered forward forecasts; BSS>0 and paper PnL>0 after fees
top_risk: Price beats the model; spread and correlated errors eat thin edge
solo_fit_reason: Cheap to test and reusable as a fair-value input to an LP bot, but as a standalone taker strategy the controlled evidence is negative, capacity is a few hundred dollars per market and fixed API costs exceed plausible gross below ~$5k.
speed_class: execution-sensitive: forecast edge lives days after listing; spread and sizing decide the sign
results_1k: forward test only; -$200 to -$50/month after API costs (guess)
min_capital: ~$5k; fixed $150-400/month LLM spend must be covered
capacity_ceiling: ~$15-30k solo; alpha dies above ~$500 per market
